You learn a Force ritual that binds a light- or vibro-weapon to you as though it were part of your own body. The ritual takes 1 hour to complete and can be performed during a short rest; the weapon must remain within your reach for its duration. At its conclusion you touch the weapon to seal the bond, gaining the following:

  • You cannot be disarmed of the bonded weapon while conscious.
  • As a bonus action, if the weapon is within 60 feet and you can see it, you may call it instantly to your hand; if your hand is full, it instead lands at your feet.
  • You may use Wisdom or Charisma in place of Strength or Dexterity for the weapon's attack and damage rolls.

You may keep up to two weapons bonded in this manner at once, and a single bonus action can summon both of them simultaneously.
